review: Reviewed all sixteen exact source/target pairs for full-size RGB PNG crop export, local folder finalization, parent directory selection, source and batch output preservation, display colours and optional spectral unmixing; placeholders and protected literals preserved. Applied three peer clarifications for local finalization and parent folder meaning; original drafts remain immutable. Standard source binding and candidate gates remain mandatory.
